author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Here is the GPT5.5 version of the Chiro posture analysis app

I have to kick the AI 3 times to get it finish the job.

The first time it just stop and ask me stupid questions where I explicitly told it DON'T ask me any questions.

The 2nd time it gave me a mock up without any ML analysis.

The last time it screwed up some minor run script in docker setup

On the other than Opus 4.7 can generate the same app in one shot

https://lnkd.in/gqk9SVDw
GitHub - hevangel/posture_health_report_gpt55 (github.com)
